1.w: But know this, that in the last days difficult times will be present.

2.w: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boasters, proud, verbally abusive, disobedient to parents, ungrateful, unholy,

3.w: unloving, unforgiving, slanderous, without control, savage, without love of good,

4.w: betrayers, reckless, having been puffed up, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

5.w: having a form of godliness but having denied its power. And turn away from these.

6.w: For out of these are those slipping into households and taking captive weak women, heaped up with sins, being led by various passions,

7.w: always learning and never being able to come to a knowledge of the truth.

8.w: Now by which way Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these oppose the truth, men having been corrupted in mind, disqualified concerning the faith.

9.w: But they will not advance much further, for their folly will be evident to all, as also that of those [two] became.

10.w: But you have closely followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, endurance,

11.w: persecutions, sufferings, such as happened to me in Antioch, in Iconium, in Lystra; what manner of persecutions I bore up under! And the Lord delivered me out of all.

12.w: And all those also wanting to live godlily in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.

13.w: But evil men and imposters will advance to the worse, deceiving and being deceived.

14.w: But you, abide in the things you learned and were convinced of, having known from whom you learned,

15.w: and that from infancy you have known the sacred writings, which are able to make you wise unto salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

16.w: Every Scripture [is] God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for conviction, for correction, [and] for training in righteousness,

17.w: so that the man of God may be complete, having been completely equipped toward every good work.
